summary: Frontend polish tickets verified end-to-end: (1) Sidebar reorg — top-level nav no longer shows Debit Note Management or Operation Log Report; both are now children of 'EIW Console' in the exact required order (Dashboard, My Transaction, Consolidated Task, Debit Note Management, My Fiscal Document, Reports, Operation Log Report, Basic Info). Routes /debit-notes and /operation-log still work when clicked from the submenu. (2) New Buyer modal (data-testid=new-buyer-modal) opens from /customers with red Section C banner, all required fields, and cascading Country/State/City/Area dropdowns. (3) New Supplier modal (data-testid=new-supplier-modal) opens from /suppliers with red Section B banner, MSIC default '(86201)General medical services', textarea, and the same cascading address block. Cascading verified: Selangor->[Shah Alam,Petaling Jaya,Subang Jaya,Klang,...], Perak->Teluk Intan->[Bandar Baru,Bandar Utama,Air Kuning], KL->[Bukit Bintang,KLCC,...]. Save flow works: filling Name=TEST_Buyer_MY, TIN=C11111100000, State=Selangor and clicking Save triggered toast 'Buyer created', modal closed, and the new row appeared in the buyers table (spot-check confirms backend POST /api/customers still accepts the flattened body).
critical_code_review_comments: Customers.jsx SectionBar uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML for a static apostrophe entity — safe today but unnecessary; prefer plain text like Suppliers.jsx does.
AddressBlock is duplicated verbatim between Customers.jsx and Suppliers.jsx (DRY violation ~40 lines). Consider extracting into /components/common/MalaysiaAddressBlock.jsx.

Recurring console warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from Recharts ResponsiveContainer on dashboard — not blocking, but should be fixed with an explicit minHeight.
seed_data_creation: Created one buyer 'TEST_Buyer_MY' with TIN C11111100000 via UI (persisted).
